safety_verdicts.content: The headache has not awakened the patient from sleep.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention whether the headache awakened the patient from sleep.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether a headache awakens a patient from sleep is a red-flag feature used in risk stratification for secondary headache causes. Omitting this negative can reduce documentation quality and may delay recognition/escalation if later clinicians assume the question was not addressed.

safety_verdicts.content: The patient has taken paracetamol only for relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated recommends paracetamol but does not document that the patient had taken only paracetamol for relief.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting what analgesics the patient has already taken (and only paracetamol) helps prevent duplicate dosing/toxicity and informs next-step treatment (e.g., adding an NSAID safely). Omission may lead to less safe or less effective self-management guidance but is unlikely to directly cause major harm in most cases.
